title: Why didn't Patrick Star stop the Ever Given from blocking the Suez Canal?
post: The Ever Given blocked the Suez Canal for 6 days in 2021... so why didn't Patrick Star stop it? Would you trade 9.6 billion dollars a day for one free scoop of ice cream? 👇 #patrickstar #spongebob #suezcanal #evergiven #nickelodeon #memes
style_suffix: 2D cartoon illustration in the classic SpongeBob SquarePants Nickelodeon style, bold outlines, vibrant colors, vertical 9:16 composition
